title: postapiauthgooglevalidtoken
description: Test POST /api/auth/google with a valid Google identity token to ensure it returns 200 with a user session and sets a session cookie.

title: postapiauthgoogleinvalidtoken
description: Test POST /api/auth/google with an invalid or missing identity token to verify it returns 401 authentication error and does not create a session.

title: postapiauthlogoutvalidsession
description: Test POST /api/auth/logout with a valid session cookie to confirm it returns 200 success and clears the session cookie.

title: postapiauthlogoutinvalidsession
description: Test POST /api/auth/logout without a valid session cookie to verify it returns an authentication error or appropriate failure response.

title: postapiwebsitegeneratevalidprompt
description: Test POST /api/website/generate with a valid prompt and authenticated session to ensure it returns 200 with a saved Website project.

title: postapiwebsitegenerateinvalidprompt
description: Test POST /api/website/generate with an empty or invalid prompt to verify it returns 400 invalid prompt and does not create a project.

title: putapiwebsiteidvalidupdate
description: Test PUT /api/website/:id with valid updated code and ownership via authenticated session to confirm it returns 200 with updated Website data.

title: putapiwebsiteidunauthorizedupdate
description: Test PUT /api/website/:id with a project ID owned by another user or invalid session to verify it returns 403 unauthorized or 404 not found and does not save changes.

title: postapipaymentcreateorderauthenticated
description: Test POST /api/payment/create-order with a selected planId and authenticated session to ensure it returns 200 with a server-created order.

title: postapipaymentverifyinvalidsignature
description: Test POST /api/payment/verify with an invalid Razorpay signature or replayed payment details to verify it returns 400 invalid signature and does not grant credits.
